info.name: MovieIntel Serving API
info.description: Example requests for the MovieIntel serving endpoints (REQ-B-4.3). The recommended path is async submit-then-poll (POST /jobs -> GET /jobs/{{job_id}}), which avoids the 30s-wall 503; synchronous POST /query is the legacy path. Set the API_URL collection variable to the deployed base URL (no trailing slash). All bodies match the QueryRequest schema in docs/openapi.yaml. Run the Submit job request first - its test script saves job_id into a collection variable so the Poll job request can run immediately after.

exec: pm.test('202 Accepted with a job_id', function () {

request.description: Expect HTTP 202 with {job_id, status: queued, poll_url}. The test script saves job_id into the collection variable; run Poll job next. This async path is not bound by the 30s gateway integration timeout.

Expect HTTP 200 with {job_id, status, progress, ...}. While status is queued/running the body carries a per-phase progress object; when terminal it carries either a 5-kind AgentResult (status=succeeded) or a structured error (status=failed). An unknown id returns 404. Send repeatedly until status is succeeded or failed.
Expect HTTP 200 with a kind=recommendations AgentResult.
Expect HTTP 200 with a kind=comparison AgentResult.
Expect HTTP 400 with an error=invalid_request ValidationErrorResponse; the agent is never invoked.
